description: B3: the warden ride's end, where the Rootwarden's grove comes into sight - shown once, never after he is at rest: safe to look at, deadly to wake.
text: The Rootwarden sleeps rooted in his grove, the dead wood round him. He does not wake to footsteps - but a blow wakes him, and he kills small giants. The woodfolk of Hollowmere know how he fights.
